ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio of approximately 75% high-intensity (white) to 25% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous central white field; low-intensity black pigmentation forms a thick, irregular border along the trailing edge and saturates both distal tips. Irregular pixel-level intrusions of black pigment are visible along the transition boundary between the white and black regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior angle of 50 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the total longitudinal fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits a distinct, larger macroscopic indentation/notch approximately 30% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary convex curvature extending from the median notch base to the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel chains (rake marks) observed on the white high-intensity surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged indentation on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, adjacent to the median notch, indicating previous tissue loss or trauma.
